qe: The 'Green Revolution' in India primarily resulted in a massive surge in the production of which agricultural staples?
qh: 'हरित क्रांति' ने मुख्य रूप से किन फसलों के उत्पादन में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि की?
e: 'Hari Kraanti' (Green Revolution) se Bharat mein gehu (wheat) aur chawal (rice) ka utpadan (production) bahut badha - 1960 ke dashak mein HYV (High Yielding Variety) beej, khad (fertilizer), sinchai (irrigation) aur kitnashak (pesticides) ka istemal badha, jismein M.S. Swaminathan aur Norman Borlaug jaise vigyanikon ka bada yogdan raha; Punjab, Haryana aur pashchimi Uttar Pradesh iske mukhya kendra bane. Iske alava 'White Revolution' (doodh) aur 'Blue Revolution' (matsya) alag kraantiyan hain. Cotton-jute (kapas-patasan) ya pulses-oilseeds is kraanti ke mukhya fayde ke kshetra nahi the - isliye sahi jod 'gehu aur chawal' hai. Exam point: Green Revolution = gehu aur chawal ka utpadan, HYV beej + khad + sinchai (1960-70 ka dashak).

qe: Which body was historically responsible for giving final approval to the draft Five Year Plans in India?
qh: भारत में पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के मसौदे को अंतिम स्वीकृति देने वाला शीर्ष निकाय कौन सा था?
e: Paanch-varsh yojnaon (Five Year Plans) ko antim manzoori (final approval) dene wali sanstha 'Rashtriya Vikas Parishad' (National Development Council - NDC) thi - iski sthapna 1952 mein hui, iske adhyaksh Pradhan Mantri hote hain aur ismein sabhi mukhya mantri (CM) aur kendra ke mantri shaamil hote hain. Yojana Aayog yojna ka masawda (draft) tay karta tha, lekin rajyaon ki sehmati (consensus) zaroori hone ke kaaran antim manzoori NDC se milti thi; isliye ise 'super cabinet' bhi kaha jaata tha. Vitta Aayog (Finance Commission) tax ka batwara karta hai, NITI Aayog ki Governing Council aaj isi ki jagah le chuki hai (2015 ke baad paanch-varsh yojnayein band), aur cabinet sachivalaya ka isse koi sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: paanch-varsh yojnaon ko antim anumodan = National Development Council (NDC), adhyaksh Pradhan Mantri.

qe: The 'Second Five Year Plan' (1956-61) was formulated on the structural economic model developed by:
qh: 'दूसरी पंचवर्षीय योजना' (1956-61) किस अर्थशास्त्री के मॉडल पर आधारित थी?
e: 1963 ke 'Yojna Aayog' ke nideshak (member) P.C. Mahalanobis the, aur unke banaye 'Mahalanobis model' par hi doosra paanch-varsh yojna (1956-61) khadi thi - is model ka dhyaan rashtra ke bhaari udyog (heavy industry), sarkaari kshetra aur nivesh (investment) badhane par tha, isliye ise 'Industrial Revolution' wali yojna bhi kaha jaata hai; iska lakshya vaarshik vikas dar (annual growth rate) lagbhag 4.5% tha. K.N. Raj, D.R. Gadgil aur Vakil-Brahmananda bhi arthashastri the, par doosri yojna ka dhaancha Mahalanobis ka hi tha. Dhyan rahe - pehli yojna (1951-56) ka dhyaan krishi (agriculture) par tha, aur doosri yojna ka udyog par. Exam point: doosri paanch-varsh yojna (1956-61) = Mahalanobis model, bhaari udyog par jor, target 4.5% growth.

qe: In which year was the First Five Year Plan formally launched in independent India?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत में प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना आधिकारिक तौर पर किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
e: Swatantrata ke baad pehli paanch-varsh yojna 1951 mein shuru hui thi (1951-56) - iska dhyaan krishi, sinchai aur dam jaise Bhakra Nangal aur Hirakud par tha, aur iska target 2.1% ki growth ka tha jise 3.6% praapt kar liya gaya (is yojna ke teht Bharat ka khadyaanaaj (foodgrains) utpadan bahut badha). 1950 samvidhan ka saal hai na ki yojna ka; 1947 azaadi ka saal; aur 1956 doosri yojna ka saal. Isliye sahi jod 1951 hai. Exam point: pehli paanch-varsh yojna = 1951 se (Harrod-Domar model par aadharit), krishi ki praadhanikta.

qe: Which Five Year Plan set out with the ambitious macroeconomic objective of achieving a 'Self-reliant and Self-generating Economy'?
qh: किस पंचवर्षीय योजना का मुख्य लक्ष्य 'आत्मनिर्भर और स्वयं-स्फूर्त अर्थव्यवस्था' प्राप्त करना था?
e: 'Atmanirbhar aur svayan-srijan (self-reliant and self-generating) arthavyavastha' wala mahatvakanshi (ambitious) lakshya teesri paanch-varsh yojna (1961-66) mein rakha gaya - iska matlab tha ki desh ko videshi madad par nirbhar (dependent) na rehna pade aur nivesh-se-bachat ka chakra khud banna chahiye. Is yojna mein Sankat: 1962 ka cheen yuddh, 1965 ka Pakistan yuddh, 1965-66 ka sukhkhal (drought) jaise karanon se lakshya pura nahi hua, aur varishth shiksha, swasthya evam udyog par bhi jor diya gaya. Fifth Plan ka lakshya 'garibi hatao aur atmanirbharta', pehli yojna ka krishi, doosri ka udyog tha - isliye sahi jod teesri yojna hai. Exam point: 'self-reliant and self-generating economy' = teesri paanch-varsh yojna (1961-66).

qe: During the 'Plan Holiday' period, in which year was the Indian Rupee devalued for the second time in history?
qh: 'प्लान हॉलिडे' अवधि के दौरान भारतीय रुपये का दूसरी बार अवमूल्यन किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: 'Plan Holiday' (yojna ka avkash) 1966 se 1969 tak teen vaarshik yojnaon (annual plans) ka samay tha - teesri yojna ke sankat (1965-66 ke sukhkhal aur yuddhon) aur videshi mudra (foreign exchange) ki kami ke karan chauthe paanch-varsh yojna ko 1969 tak tal (postpone) karna pada. Isi 'plan holiday' ke samay 1966 mein videshi mudra ki kami se nipatne ke liye rupaye ka avmulyan (devaluation) kiya gaya - ye swatantrata ke baad rupaye ka doosra avmulyan tha (pehla 1949 mein hua tha). 1971 Pakistan yuddh ka saal hai, 1969 ke aas-paas bankon ka rashtriyakaran (nationalisation) hua, aur 1974 mein alag ghatnayein hain. Exam point: plan holiday = 1966-69; rupaye ka doosra avmulyan = 1966 (pehla 1949).

qe: Which Five Year Plan explicitly adopted the tripartite slogan 'Food, Work and Productivity'?
qh: 'भोजन, काम और उत्पादकता' का नारा स्पष्ट रूप से किस पंचवर्षीय योजना द्वारा अपनाया गया था?
e: Saatvein paanch-varsh yojna (1985-90) ka mukhya naara 'khadya, kaam aur utpadan' (Food, Work and Productivity) tha - is yojna mein garibi unmulan (poverty alleviation), rozgar (employment) ke avsar, khadyan utpadan aur samajaadi nyay par jor diya gaya, saath hi vikaas dar badhane ke liye takniki adhunikikaran (modernisation) aur kheti mein utpadakta (productivity) ko badhava diya gaya. Paanchvi yojna (1974-78) 'garibi hatao' ke liye jaani jaati hai, chhathi yojna (1980-85) arthavyavastha ke sudharan (structural adjustment) ke liye, aur dasvin yojna (2002-07) 8% growth target ke liye. Exam point: 'Food, Work and Productivity' = saatvin paanch-varsh yojna (1985-90).

qe: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) was established in 1969 during which Five Year Plan timeframe?
qh: 1969 में ISRO की स्थापना किस पंचवर्षीय योजना की समय-सीमा के भीतर हुई थी?
e: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) ki sthapna 15 August 1969 mein hui thi, jo chauthe paanch-varsh yojna ke kaal (1969-74) ke samay hai - yahi yojna ka samay tha jab bharat ne 'Green Revolution' aur antariksh kshetra mein aatmanirbharta par zor diya. ISRO ka mukhyaalay Bengaluru mein hai aur ye Department of Space ke teht aata hai; ISRO ke pahle kendra (Thumba, 1963) aur INCOSPAR (1962) pehle ke the, par ISRO ka gathan 1969 mein hi hua. Teesri yojna 1961-66 thi, paanchvi 1974-78 aur chhathi 1980-85 - isliye ISRO ka sahi yojna-kaal chautti (Fourth) hai. Exam point: ISRO ki sthapna = 15 August 1969, chauthe paanch-varsh yojna (1969-74) ke dauran.

qe: The poverty eradication campaign 'Garibi Hatao' was institutionalized as a primary national objective in which plan?
qh: गरीबी उन्मूलन का नारा 'गरीबी हटाओ' किस योजना में एक प्राथमिक राष्ट्रीय उद्देश्य के रूप में संस्थागत किया गया था?
e: 'Garibi Hatao' ka naara Indira Gandhi ne 1971 ke chunav ke dauran lagaya tha, aur ise paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78) mein rashtriya uddeshya (national objective) ke roop mein sthapit kiya gaya - is yojna ke do mukhya maksad the: 'garibi unmeelan (poverty removal) aur atmanirbharta (self-reliance)'. Isi ke teht 'Minimum Needs Programme', garibi-hatane wali rozgar yojnayein aur samajaadi suraksha (social security) jaise kaam shuru hue. Chauthe, saatvein aur teesri yojnayein alag vishayon ke liye jaani jaati hain - isliye garibi hatao ka jod paanchvi yojna hi hai. Exam point: 'Garibi Hatao' = paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78); do lakshya - garibi hatao aur atmanirbharta.

qe: What was the final approved GDP growth target set for the 12th and last Five Year Plan (2012-17)?
qh: 12वीं और अंतिम पंचवर्षीय योजना (2012-17) के लिए स्वीकृत अंतिम जीडीपी विकास लक्ष्य क्या था?
e: 12vi aur antim paanch-varsh yojna (2012-17) ka anumodit (approved) GDP vikaas dar ka lakshya 8.0% rakha gaya tha - yahi first plan tha jismein 'faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth' wali soch ke saath samaveshi (inclusive) vikas aur saamarthya (hr) nirman par zor diya gaya. 12vi yojna ke baad 2015-17 ke baad paanch-varsh yojnaon ka chalan band ho gaya aur NITI Aayog ne 15-varsh ka 'Vision 2030' aur trivarishiya karyayojna ka dhaancha apnaya. 9.0%, 10.0% ya 7.0% aankde is yojna ke'anumodit lakshya nahi the. Exam point: 12vi paanch-varsh yojna (2012-17) ka GDP lakshya = 8.0%; yahi antim paanch-varsh yojna thi.

qe: Which Five Year Plan was terminated prematurely in 1978, a year before its scheduled completion?
qh: कौन सी पंचवर्षीय योजना 1978 में अपने निर्धारित समय से एक वर्ष पहले ही समाप्त कर दी गई थी?
e: Paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78) ko 1978 mein ek saal pehle hi samapt kar diya gaya - 1977 ke aam chunav ke baad Janata Party ki sarkar ne aayi aur usne is yojna ko bhang kar diya, isi ke saath 1978-80 ko 'Rolling Plan' (agla yojna tay hone tak chalta samay) ke roop mein chalaya gaya. 1978 ke baad chhathi yojna (1980-85) laayi gayi. Aathvin (1992-97), chautte (1969-74) aur chhatti (1980-85) yojnayein apne nirdharit samay par ya uske aas-paas chalin, isliye 'ek saal pehle khatm hone wali yojna' paanchvi hi hai. Exam point: paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78) 1978 mein ek saal pehle samapt; baad mein rolling plan ka prayog.

qe: The 'Integrated Rural Development Programme' (IRDP) was launched countrywide under which Five Year Plan?
qh: 'एकीकृत ग्रामीण विकास कार्यक्रम' (IRDP) देश भर में किस पंचवर्षीय योजना के तहत शुरू किया गया था?
e: Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP) 1978-79 mein shuru hua tha, par ise desh bhar mein chhathi paanch-varsh yojna (1980-85) ke teht garibi ke viruddh mukhya karyakram ke roop mein chalaya gaya - iske teht gaareeb parivaron ko gaay-bakra, hand-pump, dukan jaise utpaadan (productive assets) dilaye jaate the taaki wo apni zindagi chala sakein. Chhathi yojna ka mukhya naara bhi 'garibi hatao' hi tha aur ismein NREP (National Rural Employment Programme) bhi shaamil tha. Chautte, paanchvi ya aathvin yojnayein is yojna ke liye nahi jaani jaati; IRDP ko baad mein Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1989) mein mila diya gaya. Exam point: IRDP ka deshbhar mein karyanvayan = chhathi paanch-varsh yojna (1980-85), andhere mein bhi garib parivar ko utpaadan dilana.

qe: The landmark 'Operation Flood' (White Revolution) was launched in India during which operational Five Year Plan?
qh: 'ऑपरेशन फ्लड' (श्वेत क्रांति) भारत में किस पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान शुरू किया गया था?
e: 'Operation Flood' (Shwet Kraanti - White Revolution) 1970 mein shuru hui thi, jo chautte paanch-varsh yojna (1969-74) ka kaal tha - iska naayak Verghese Kurien aur sanstha NDDB (National Dairy Development Board, Anand, Gujarat) thi, jisne doodh utpadak sahkari samitiyon (milk cooperatives) ke zariye doodh ke utpadan aur vitaran (distribution) ka jaal khada kiya, aur Amul iska nishaan bana. Iske alava 'Yellow Revolution' (telhaan), 'Blue Revolution' (matsya) aur 'Pink Revolution' (jheenga/prawn) alag kraantiyan hain. Isliye '1970' wala kaal chautti yojna se jodta hai, paanchvi ya saatvein se nahi. Exam point: Operation Flood = 1970 (Verghese Kurien, NDDB), chautte paanch-varsh yojna (1969-74) ke dauran.

qe: Under which Prime Minister's tenure was the 'Minimum Needs Programme' (MNP) introduced in Indian planning?
qh: भारतीय नियोजन में 'न्यूनतम आवश्यकता कार्यक्रम' (MNP) किस प्रधानमंत्री के कार्यकाल में शुरू किया गया था?
e: 'Minimum Needs Programme' (MNP) paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78) ke dauran laaya gaya, aur us samay Pradhan Mantri Indira Gandhi thi - iska maksad samaj ke sabse kamzor vargon ko shiksha, swasthya, peene ka paani, ghar aur sadak jaise zaroori (minimum) saadhan dilana tha, taaki garibi ke khilaf ladai mein sahi madad mile. MNP ke teht prathmik shiksha, gramin swasthya, rural paani-aapurti, rural sadak, gramin vidyutikaran aur jhopadpatti (slum) sudhar jaise kaam aate the. Jawaharlal Nehru pehli yojna ke dauran the (1951-64), Morarji Desai 1978 ke baad aayi Janata sarkar ke, aur Shastri 1964-66 ke dauran - isliye MNP ka jod Indira Gandhi ke Fifth Plan se hai. Exam point: Minimum Needs Programme = paanchvi paanch-varsh yojna (1974-78), Indira Gandhi ke kaal mein.

qe: The rural employment scheme 'Jawahar Rozgar Yojana' (JRY) was initiated during which Five Year Plan?
qh: 'जवाहर रोजगार योजना' (JRY) किस पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान शुरू की गई थी?
e: 'Jawahar Rozgar Yojana' (JRY) 1989 mein shuru hui, jo saatvein paanch-varsh yojna (1985-90) ka kaal tha - ismein puraani do yojnaon NREP (National Rural Employment Programme) aur RLEGP (Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme) ko mila kar ek nayi yojna banayi gayi, jiska maksad gaon mein bezgari (unemployment) kam karna aur gaon mein sadak, talab, school-bhavan jaise nirmaan se rozgar dena tha. Iske baad 1990-2000 ke aas-paas Employment Assurance Scheme (EAS) aur baad mein Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) aur MGNREGA aayi. Chunki JRY ki sthapna 1989 mein hui, isliye ise saatvein yojna se joda jaata hai, chhathi ya aathvin se nahi. Exam point: Jawahar Rozgar Yojana = 1989, saatvein paanch-varsh yojna (1985-90); NREP + RLEGP ka sammilan.

qe: The 'Eighth Five Year Plan' (1992-97) could not be launched on time in 1990 primarily due to:
qh: आठवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1992-97) 1990 में समय पर शुरू क्यों नहीं हो सकी थी?
o: Supreme Court stay on planning expenditure
Severe political instability at the Centre and the Balance of Payments economic crisis
e: Aathvin paanch-varsh yojna (1992-97) 1990 mein samay par shuru nahi ho payi, kyunki us samay kendra mein rajniti asthirsthata (political instability) thi - 1989-1991 ke beech teen sarkarein badli (VP Singh, Chandra Shekhar, aur 1991 ke chunav ke baad P.V. Narasimha Rao), aur saath hi 1991 mein videshi mudra (Balance of Payments) ka gambhir sankat aaya jisne bharat ko IMF ke paas jaane par majboor kiya aur LPG sudhar (liberalisation) shuru kie. Isi karan 1990-92 ke do saal yojna ke bina (annual plan ke roop mein) nikal gaye; aise hi badi partiyon ki himmat se 1992 mein aathvin yojna shuru hui. Chunav-prakriya ya postal hartaal is mamle ke kaaran nahi the. Exam point: 1992 mein deri ka kaaran = kendra ki rajnitik asthirsthata + 1991 ka BoP sankat (jiske baad LPG sudhar).

qe: During which Five Year Plan was the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) established?
qh: राष्ट्रीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक (NABARD) की स्थापना किस योजना के दौरान हुई थी?
e: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) ki sthapna 12 July 1982 mein hui, jo chhathi paanch-varsh yojna (1980-85) ka kaal tha - iska kaam kheti (agriculture), gaon ke chhote udyog aur rural vikas ke liye punarvitt (refinance) sahayata pahunchana hai; isne RBI ke 'Agricultural Credit Department' aur 'Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation (ARDC)' ka kaam sambhala. Iske alava chhathi yojna mein IRDP, NREP aur TRYSEM jaise kaam bhi hue. Paanchvi, saatvein ya chautti yojna NABARD ki sthapna ke vardan nahi hain, isliye sahi jod chhathi yojna hai. Exam point: NABARD ki sthapna = 12 July 1982, chhathi paanch-varsh yojna (1980-85) ke dauran; mukhyaalay Mumbai mein.

qe: Who served as the very first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission of India in 1950?
qh: 1950 में भारत के योजना आयोग के पहले उपाध्यक्ष के रूप में किसने कार्य किया था?
e: Yojna Aayog (Planning Commission) ke pehle Upadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman) 1950 mein Gulzarilal Nanda the - Pradhan Mantri khud Yojna Aayog ke adhyaksh hote the, isliye vyavharik niyantran Upadhyaksh ke haath mein tha. V.T. Krishnamachari aur C.D. Deshmukh aage chal kar is pad par rahe (Deshmukh 1950 ke aas-paas vitta mantri bhi the), aur P.C. Mahalanobis ek mahatvapurn sadasya (member) the, Upadhyaksh nahi. Isliye sahi naam Gulzarilal Nanda hai, jinhe baad mein do baar kaaryavahak Pradhan Mantri banane ka mauka bhi mila. Exam point: Yojna Aayog ke pehle Upadhyaksh = Gulzarilal Nanda (1950); adhyaksh Pradhan Mantri rahate the.

qe: The Bokaro Steel Plant was initiated with technical and financial assistance from the Soviet Union during which Plan?
qh: बोकारो स्टील प्लांट की स्थापना सोवियत संघ की सहायता से किस योजना के दौरान शुरू की गई थी?
e: Bokaro Steel Plant ki neev soviet sangh (USSR) ki arthik aur takniki madad se rakhi gayi thi, aur ye teesri paanch-varsh yojna (1961-66) ke kaal mein aaya - iske pehle Bhilai (1955) aur Rourkela (1957) doosri yojna ke teht aaye the (Bhilai USSR ki madad se, Rourkela Germany ki madad se), aur isi tarah Durgapur (UK ki madad se) bhi doosri yojna mein tha. Bokaro ki sandhi (agreement) 1964 mein hui, isliye teesri yojna ka sahi jod hai. Isliye 'sovet madad = doosri' wala saamaanya dharna hamesha sahi nahi hota - yahan Bokaro teesri yojna se juda hai. Exam point: Bokaro Steel Plant = teesri paanch-varsh yojna (1961-66), USSR ki madad se; Bhilai-Rourkela-Durgapur doosri yojna mein.

qe: What is the structural distinction between 'First Generation' and 'Second Generation' economic reforms in India?
qh: भारत में 'प्रथम पीढ़ी' और 'द्वितीय पीढ़ी' के आर्थिक सुधारों के बीच संरचनात्मक अंतर क्या है?
o: First gen was agricultural, Second gen was industrial
First gen was fully funded by IMF, Second gen by World Bank
First gen focused on external macro-reforms (LPG), while Second gen focuses on deep institutional, governance, and factor-market reforms
e: Pehli pidhi (First Generation) ke aarthik sudhar 1991 ke LPG (Udarikaran-Liberalisation, Nijiikaran-Privatisation, Vaishvikaran-Globalisation) ke teht 'bahri aur macro' (baahar ke niyam, vyapar, mudra, videshi nivesh aur aay-kar) sudhar the - inka maksad videshi mudra ke sankat se niptna aur sarkari niyantran ghataana tha. Doosri pidhi (Second Generation) ke sudhar gehre, sansthaagat (institutional) aur 'factor market' wale hain - jaise shram (labour) kanoon, zameen (land) ke niyam, bijli aur vitaran (distribution) sudhar, sarkari sasta saaman (subsidy) ka sudhar, nyayik sansthaon ki sudhara aur shaasan (governance) ko paardarshi banana. Dono ek jaise nahi hain, na hi pehla krishi aur doosra udyog hai - isliye sahi antar 'pehla macro/baahri, doosra sansthaagat' wala hai. Exam point: First gen = 1991 LPG (macro/external); Second gen = sansthaagat, factor-market aur governance sudhar.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution confers constitutional recognition and provisions for Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities)?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद नगर पालिकाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान करता है?
e: Shahri sthaaniya sansthaon (Urban Local Bodies/Nagarpalika) ka samvidhanik aadhar Part IXA hai, jo 74th sanshodhan sanvidhan (1992/93) se joda gaya - iske pravdhan Article 243P se 243ZG tak faile hain, jismein nagar panchayat, nagar parishad aur nagar nigam ka gathan, ward committee, nagar vikas (planning) samiti aur unke chunav ki vyavastha hai. Article 243 se 243-O tak Part IX (Panchayati Raj, 73th sanshodhan) ke pravdhan hain - ye gaon wale sansthaon ke liye hain, shahron ke liye nahi. Article 244-244A anusuchit (Scheduled) kshetron ke liye aur 350-350B bhaashik alpsankhyakon ke liye hain. Exam point: nagarpalikayein = Part IXA, Article 243P-243ZG (74th sanshodhan); panchayat = Part IX, 243-243O (73th).

qe: Under Article 50 of the Constitution, what institutional separation is mandated as a Directive Principle?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 50 के तहत किस संस्थागत पृथक्करण को अनिवार्य किया गया है?
o: Separation of religion from administrative governance
Separation of taxation powers between Centre and States
Separation of the Judiciary from the Executive in the public services of the State
Separation of civil aviation from defense forces
e: Article 50 (DPSP) kehta hai ki rajya aise kadam uthega jo lok sevaon mein nyayapalika (judiciary) ko karyapalika (executive) se alag karne ke liye zaroori hain - iska matlab yahi hai ki jo aadhikarik (executive) adhikari jaanch-ta hai aur saza deta hai (jaise purane jilla adhikari/magistrate), wo kaam aage chal kar swatantra nyayapalika ke paas jaana chahiye. Isi nirdesh ke teht 1970 ke aas-paas alag 'nyayik seva' (separate judicial service) aur nyayadhiish wale alag pad bane (JMFC/Civil Judge), jisse nyay ki nishpakshata badhi; kyunki jab karyapalika hi saza deti hai to nishpakshata par sandeh hota hai. Dharm aur prashasan ka alag hona, tax-shakti ka bantwara ya aviation ka raksha se alag hona, samvidhan mein aise nirdesh nahi hain. Exam point: Article 50 = lok sevaon mein nyayapalika ko karyapalika se alag karna (DPSP), isi se alag nyayik seva ka janm.

qe: What structural modification did the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act (2002) bring to Article 45 of Part IV?
qh: 86वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम (2002) ने भाग IV के अनुच्छेद 45 में क्या बदलाव किया?
o: Shifted education entirely to the State List
Extended free education up to university graduation
Replaced primary education with early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years
e: 86th samvidhan sanshodhan (2002) ne Article 45 ka poora roop badal diya - pehle Article 45 kehta tha ki rajya 6 saal ke bachchon ke liye muft-anivarya shiksha ki vyavastha karega (bade bachchon ke liye), lekin shiksha ka mool adhikar (Article 21A) aane ke baad 45 ka naya roop yahi bana ki rajya sabhi bachchon ki 'aayu 6 saal pura hone tak' shishu dekhbhal (early childhood care) aur shiksha ki vyavastha karega - yani 0-6 saal ke bachchon ki dekhbhal ka kaam DPSP ke roop mein Article 45 ke paas aa gaya. 6-14 saal ke bachchon ke liye shiksha ab mool adhikar (21A) hai, aur isi tarah sarkari shiksha ke kshetra-bantware (education ka State List se Concurrent List mein jaana) ka mamla bhi 42th sanshodhan se juda hai. Exam point: 86th sanshodhan (2002) = Article 45 ab 0-6 saal ke bachchon ki shishu dekhbhal aur shiksha ke liye; 6-14 saal ke liye Article 21A mool adhikar.

qe: Article 43B of the Directive Principles of State Policy, promoting voluntary formation of cooperative societies, was added by which amendment?
qh: सहकारी समितियों के गठन को बढ़ावा देने वाला अनुच्छेद 43B किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: Article 43B, jo sahkari samitiyon (cooperative societies) ke swaichchhik gathan (voluntary formation), swayam-shaasan (autonomous functioning) aur peshevar (professional) prabandhan ki baat karta hai, 97th samvidhan sanshodhan, 2011 dwara DPSP mein joda gaya. Usi 97th sanshodhan ne samvidhan mein Part IXB (Article 243ZH se 243ZT) bhi joda, jismein sahkari samitiyon ke gathan aur unke karyon ke niyam tay hue - yani ye sanshodhan sahkari aandolan (cooperative movement) ko samvidhanik manyata dene ke liye tha. 42th sanshodhan (1976) DPSP mein 39A, 43A, 48A jaise pravdhan jodne ke liye, 73th sanshodhan panchayat ke liye aur 86th sanshodhan shiksha ke liye jaana jaata hai. Exam point: Article 43B (sahkari samitiyan) = 97th sanshodhan 2011; isi sanshodhan se Part IXB bhi aaya.

qe: Why was the prohibition of cow slaughter included in Article 48 of the Indian Constitution?
qh: गोवध पर प्रतिबंध को भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 48 में क्यों शामिल किया गया था?
o: As a combined directive on modern agriculture, animal husbandry, and preserving breeds of milch and draught cattle
As an emergency food conservation measure
As a fundamental right of farmers
e: Article 48 (DPSP) mein teen baatein ek saath kehi gayi hain - (1) krishi aur pashupalan (animal husbandry) ko adhunik vaigyanik dhang (modern scientific lines) se vyavasthit karna, (2) nasl (breeds) ki sudhara aur unke sanrakshan, aur (3) gaay, bachhde aur anya doodh/kaam dene wale pshuon ke vadh par rok. Gaay vadh (cow slaughter) par rok aarthik karan se bhi judi hai - doodh aur khad (manure) ke liye doodh dene wale pashuon ki saankhya bani rehni chahiye, aur krishi ke liye bel/bhains (draught cattle) zaroori hain; isliye ye ek 'milks + draught cattle' wala sammilita nirdesh hai. Yad rakhein ye DPSP hai, mool adhikar nahi - isliye ispar seedha writ nahi milta. Exam point: Article 48 = krishi-pashupalan ka adhunikikaran, nasl sudhara, aur doodh/kaam dene wale pshuon ke vadh par rok (DPSP).

qe: Under Article 41, the State is directed to make effective provision for securing the Right to Work and Education primarily in cases of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 41 के तहत राज्य को किन परिस्थितियों में काम और शिक्षा का अधिकार सुरक्षित करने का निर्देश दिया गया है?
o: Unemployment, old age, sickness, and disablement within the limits of its economic capacity
e: Article 41 (DPSP) rajya ko nirdesh deta hai ki wo apni aarthik kshmata (economic capacity) aur vikas ke star ki seema ke andar kaam (work), shiksha (education) aur 'bura haal' wale mamlon mein sahayata (public assistance) dene ki prabhavi vyavastha kare - jaise bezgari (unemployment), budhapa (old age), bimari (sickness) aur viklangta (disablement) jaise mamle. Isi ke teht MGNREGA (rozgar), Old Age Pension, aur anya social security yojnayein banti hain. Rashtriy chunav, ya videshi yuddh, ya niji company ka diwaliya (bankruptcy) is nirdesh ke mamle nahi hain - isliye sahi jod 'bezgari, budhapa, bimari, viklangta' hai. Exam point: Article 41 = kaam, shiksha aur bezgari/budhapa/bimari/viklangta mein sahayata ka nirdesh (aarthik kshmata ki seema ke andar).

qe: Article 38(2), which directs the State to minimize inequalities in income, status, facilities, and opportunities, was inserted by:
qh: आय, स्थिति और सुविधाओं में असमानताओं को कम करने का निर्देश देने वाला अनुच्छेद 38(2) किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: Article 38(2) kehta hai ki rajya aay (income), darje (status), suvidhaon (facilities) aur avsar (opportunities) mein badhti ashmanataon (inequalities) ko kam karne ka prayas karega - aur ye khand 44th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1978 dwara joda gaya tha (Article 38(1) samajaadi-aarthik-rajnitik nyay ka purana nirdesh pehle se tha). Is naye khand ka tark yahi hai ki keval samanata ka aadesh kaafi nahi, balki asmanataon ko ghatane ke liye sakriya (active) kadam chahiye. 42th sanshodhan ne DPSP mein 39A, 43A aur 48A jaisi dharayein jodi, 91th ne mantri-parishad ke aakaar ko seemit kiya, aur 24th sanshodhan ne sanshodhan-shakti ki seema spasht ki. Exam point: Article 38(2) = aay-darje-suvidha-avsar ki asmanataon ko ghatane ka nirdesh, 44th sanshodhan 1978 se joda gaya.

qe: Under Article 54, which category of legislators is constitutionally barred from voting in the election of the President of India?
qh: अनुच्छेद 54 के तहत किन जनप्रतिनिधियों को राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में मतदान करने से संवैधानिक रूप से बाहर रखा गया है?
o: Nominated members of both Houses of Parliament and members of State Legislative Councils (MLCs)
Elected members of the Legislative Assembly of Puducherry
e: Article 54 ke anusaar rashtrapati ke chunav ke liye nirvachak mandal (Electoral College) mein sansad ke dono sadan ke nirvachit (elected) sadasya aur rajya vidhan sabhaon ke nirvachit sadasya hote hain - ismein sansad ke 'naamit' (nominated) sadasya aur vidhan parishad (MLC) ke sadasya shaamil nahi hote. Iska tark yahi hai ki rashtrapati rajyaon aur janta ke pratinidhi hain, isliye naamit sadasya (jinhe janta ne nahi chuna) vote nahi dete; aur 70th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1992 ke baad Delhi aur Puducherry ke vidhan sabha ke nirvachit sadasya bhi vote dete hain, jabki J&K ke UT ban jaane ke baad wahan ke vidhayak nahi dete. Exam point: rashtrapati ke chunav mein vote nahi dete = sansad ke nominated sadasya aur vidhan parishad (MLC) ke sadasya (Article 54).

qe: Under Article 123, what is the maximum possible lifespan of an Ordinance issued by the President without parliamentary re-approval?
qh: अनुच्छेद 123 के तहत बिना संसदीय मंजूरी के राष्ट्रपति के अध्यादेश का अधिकतम संभावित जीवनकाल क्या होता है?
e: Article 123 ke anusaar rashtrapati jab vidheyak (bill) na ho paane wali aakaalik parishiti mein adhyadesh (Ordinance) jaari karte hain, to uski aayu 6 mahine tak hoti hai (agar sansad dobara na baithe), aur jab vidhan mandal punah baithta hai to adhyadesh ko 6 hafte ke andar sansad ke samaksh rakh kar manzoori karani hoti hai, aur vidhan mandal ke dobara baithe (reassembly) se 6 hafte ki avadhi milti hai - isliye uski adhiktam aayu (lifespan) 6 mahine + 6 hafte tak pahunch sakti hai. Isliye '12 mahine' ya 'keval 6 hafte' wale vikalp galat hain; 6 mahine (sammon tak ki) + 6 hafte (baithak ke baad) ka jod sahi hai. Adhyadesh keval usi samay jaari hota hai jab sansad ke dono sadan satr (session) mein na ho. Exam point: vyakhya (Ordinance) - adhyadesh ki adhiktam aayu 6 mahine + 6 hafte (Article 123); sansad ki manzoori zaroori.

qe: Under Article 72, what does the pardoning term 'Respite' specifically denote?
qh: अनुच्छेद 72 के तहत क्षमादान की शक्ति में 'विराम' (Respite) का क्या विशिष्ट अर्थ है?
o: Substituting death sentence with simple life detention
Awarding a lesser punishment in place of one originally prescribed due to special factual grounds (such as pregnancy or physical disability)
e: Article 72 ke teht rashtrapati ki kshama-shakti ke paanch roop hote hain - pardon (poori maafi), commutation (saza ko badal kar halki karna), remission (saza ki avadhi kam karna), respite (ghatak special mamlon ke karan saza kam karna) aur reprieve (saza par thodi der ke liye rok). 'Respite' ka khaas arth yahi hai ki khaas tathyon (special factual grounds) ke kaaran saza mein kami - jaise mahila garbhavati (pregnant) ho ya vyakti physically disabled ho; isliye saza mool rup se tay hoti hai par uske anusaar badal (substitute) hoti hai. 'Poori maafi' pardon hai, 'saza ka substitution' aur 'procedural delay' iske arth nahi hain. Exam point: Article 72 mein 'respite' = khaas tathyon (jaise pregnancy ya physical disability) ke aadhar par halki saza dena; maut ki saza bhi rashtrapati se judi shaktiyon mein aati hai.

qe: How is the value of vote of an elected MLA calculated in the Presidential election?
qh: राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में एक निर्वाचित विधायक के मत का मूल्य कैसे निकाला जाता है?
o: Total State Population (1971 census) / (Total Elected MLAs x 1000)
Fixed at 100 points for all States
Total State Revenue / Total Registered Voters
e: Rashtrapati ke chunav mein ek nirvachit MLA (Vidhayak) ke vote ka mulya is formula se nikaala jaata hai: us rajya ki jansankhya (1971 ki jangna ke aadhar par) ko 'kul nirvachit vidhayakon ki sankhya x 1000' se bhaaga diya jaata hai - is tarah bade rajya ke MLA ke paas zyada mulya hota hai aur chhote rajya ke paas kam. Isse yahi sunishchit hota hai ki rashtrapati ke chunav mein rajyaon ki jansankhya ka aadhaar mahatva rakhta hai. 1971 ki jangna isliye tay hui ki pichhli jangna par adharit mulya kai bar badalne se vote ka mulya kam ho jaata (2031 tak 1971 wala aadhar jaari rahega, 84th sanshodhan ke baad). 'Sabhi rajyaon ke liye 100' wala formula naamit sadasya ya kisi aur chunav ka nahi hai. Exam point: rashtrapati chunav mein ek MLA ke vote ka mulya = rajya ki jansankhya (1971) / (nirvachit vidhayakon ki sankhya x 1000).

qe: Why can the President of India NOT return a Money Bill to Parliament for reconsideration under Article 111?
qh: राष्ट्रपति अनुच्छेद 111 के तहत किसी धन विधेयक (Money Bill) को पुनर्विचार के लिए संसद को वापस क्यों नहीं भेज सकते?
o: Because the Rajya Sabha holds absolute power over finances
Because the Speaker's certificate is unreviewable
Because Money Bills are introduced in the Lok Sabha only with the prior recommendation of the President
Because Money Bills are passed by joint sittings
e: Article 111 ke anusaar rashtrapati kisi vidheyak (bill) par anumodan (assent) de sakte hain, ruk sakte hain, ya (gair-dhan vidheyak ho to) sadan ko punarvichar (reconsideration) ke liye wapas bhej sakte hain - lekin 'paise ke vidheyak' (Money Bill) ko wapas nahi bhej sakte, kyunki Money Bill sadan mein rashtrapati ki purv-sifarish (prior recommendation) se hi pesh hota hai (Article 117(1)); rashtrapati uske dwara aage badhe maamlon aur uske aarthik vishayon se pehle hi soochit rehte hain. Isliye rashtrapati ka us vidheyak ke niptan mein poori tayyari hoti hai aur wapas bhejne ka sawaal nahi uthta; wo uspar anumodan de dete hain. 'Rajya Sabha ka niyam' ya 'Speaker ka praman' wale vikalp asli karan nahi hain. Exam point: Money Bill wapas nahi bhej sakte (Article 111) kyunki uski peshkash hi rashtrapati ki sifarish se hoti hai (Article 117(1)).

qe: If both the offices of the President and Vice-President fall vacant simultaneously, which statute governs who shall act as President?
qh: यदि राष्ट्रपति और उपराष्ट्रपति दोनों के पद एक साथ रिक्त हो जाएं, तो कौन सा कानून कार्यवाहक राष्ट्रपति तय करता है?
o: Government of India Allocation of Business Rules
e: Jab rashtrapati aur uprashtrapati dono ke pad ek saath khaali ho jaayein, to kaun rashtrapati ke kartavya nibhayega, iska niyam 'President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969' mein diya gaya hai - iske anusaar Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish (Chief Justice of India) karyavahak rashtrapati ban sakte hain, aur agar wo bhi upalabdh na hon to uchchatam nyayalay ke sabse varishth (senior-most) nyayadhish us pad par baith sakte hain. Aise samay mein 6 mahine ke andar naye rashtrapati ka chunav karana hota hai. Rashtrapati ke chunav/tran-janpratinidhi se jude kanoon (Representation of the People Act), Supreme Court Rules ya Allocation of Business Rules is vishay ke liye nahi hain. Exam point: dono pad khaali = President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969 - CJI ya senior-most SC judge karyavahak rashtrapati.

qe: Under Article 201, what options are available to the President when a State Bill is reserved by a Governor?
qh: अनुच्छेद 201 के तहत जब कोई राज्य विधेयक राज्यपाल द्वारा आरक्षित किया जाता है, तो राष्ट्रपति के पास क्या विकल्प होते हैं?
o: The President must refer it to the Inter-State Council
The bill automatically lapses if not signed within six months
The President must grant assent within 30 days
The President may either assent, withhold assent, or direct the Governor to return it to the State Legislature (non-money bill)
e: Article 201 ke anusaar jab koi rajya ka vidheyak (bill) Rajyapal dwara rashtrapati ke vichaar ke liye aarakshit (reserved) kiya jaata hai, to rashtrapati ke paas teen vikalp hote hain - (1) vidheyak par anumodan (assent) dena, (2) anumodan rokna (withhold), ya (3) agar vidheyak money bill na ho to Rajyapal ko nirdesh dena ki use rajya vidhan mandal ko punarvichar ke liye wapas bheja jaye (yah to sadan usmein sanshodhan kar sakti hai). Iske alava rashtrapati us bill ko rok bhi sakte hain (jaisa kuchh mamlon mein hua), par 'chhe mahine mein lap ho jaana', '30 din mein anumodan dena' ya 'Inter-State Council ko bhejna' samvidhan mein nahi hai. Exam point: Article 201 = rashtrapati teen vikalp istemal kar sakte hain - anumodan, rok, ya Rajyapal ko wapas bhejne ka nirdesh (gair-dhan vidheyak ke liye).

qe: What is the required security deposit that every candidate contesting the Presidential election must deposit with the RBI?
qh: राष्ट्रपति चुनाव लड़ने वाले प्रत्येक उम्मीदवार को RBI में कितनी जमानत राशि जमा करनी होती है?
e: Rashtrapati ke chunav mein khada hone wale pratyashi (candidate) ko Reserve Bank of India ke paas jama karne wali jama rashi (security deposit) Rs 15,000 hoti hai - yahi RPA (Representation of the People Act, 1951) aur Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952 ke niyam se tay hai. Iske alava pratyashi ke liye kuchh nirdharit (proposers/seconders) ki sankhya aur ek nomination ki shart hoti hai; Rs 50,000, 25,000 ya 5,000 wale aankde kisi aur chunav (Lok Sabha/Assembly) se juda niyam hain, rashtrapati ke chunav se nahi. Exam point: rashtrapati ke chunav mein security deposit = Rs 15,000 (RBI mein jama), Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952 ke teht.

qe: Under Article 262 of the Constitution, what power is vested in Parliament regarding inter-state river water disputes?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 262 के तहत अंतर-राज्यीय नदी जल विवादों के संबंध में संसद को क्या शक्ति प्राप्त है?
o: Parliament must directly act as the jury and decide allocations
Parliament must transfer all disputed rivers to the Union List
Parliament may by law provide for the adjudication of such disputes and bar the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and all other courts
Parliament can order the deployment of the military to control water reservoirs
e: Article 262 ke anusaar antarraajya nadi-jal vivadon (inter-state river water disputes) ke mamle mein Parliament kanoon bana kar unke samadhan (adjudication) ki vyavastha kar sakti hai aur kisi anya adalat ya Supreme Court ka adhikar bhi khatm (bar) kar sakti hai - isi ke teht 1956 mein Inter-State River Water Disputes Act aaya aur Cauvery, Krishna, Godavari, Ravi-Beas jaise tribunal bane (jaise Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal). Isliye rashtrapati ya military ka koi role nahi, aur samvidhan-kachahari (court) ka dakhal is vishay par bhara teevr hi bandh kar diya gaya. Exam point: Article 262 = antarraajya nadi-jal vivadon ke liye Parliament ka kanoon + adalat ke dakhal par rok; isi se Water Disputes Act aur tribunals bane.

qe: Under Article 248 of the Constitution, in whom are the 'Residuary Powers' of legislation vested in the Indian federal system?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 248 के तहत भारतीय संघीय व्यवस्था में कानून बनाने की 'अवशिष्ट शक्तियां' किसमें निहित हैं?
o: Concurrent jurisdiction of Centre and States
The President of India acting with the Inter-State Council
e: Article 248 ke anusaar vidhayik (legislative) 'shesh shaktiyan' (residuary powers) - yani wo vishay jo teen suchiyon (Union, State, Concurrent) mein kahin nahi likhe hain - keval Parliament ke paas hain; Union List ki entry 97 aur Concurrent/State se bache vishay isi ke daayre mein aate hain. Australia aur Canada jaisi federations mein shesh shaktiyan rajyaon ke paas hoti hain, par Bharatiya vyavastha ne America ke andaaz mein ise kendra ke paas rakha, taaki naye-aaye vishay par koi khaali jagah (vacuum) na bane. Rajyaon ya rashtrapati ke paas ye shakti nahi hai - isliye 'Parliament exclusively' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Residuary powers = keval Parliament (Article 248 + Union List entry 97); kyunki anya federations mein ye rajyaon ke paas hoti hain.

qe: Under Article 249, how can Parliament acquire temporary power to make laws on a subject enumerated in the State List?
qh: अनुच्छेद 249 के तहत संसद राज्य सूची के किसी विषय पर कानून बनाने की अस्थायी शक्ति कैसे प्राप्त कर सकती है?
o: Through a direct executive order from the Prime Minister
By a simple majority resolution passed in the Lok Sabha
If the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution supported by not less than two-thirds of members present and voting declaring it necessary in national interest
On a joint requisition signed by all State Governors
e: Article 249 ke anusaar agar Rajya Sabha ek prastav (resolution) paas kare ki rashtriya hit (national interest) mein Parliament ko rajya-suchi (State List) ke kisi vishay par kanoon banana chahiye, to Parliament ko us vishay par kanoon banane ki shakti mil jaati hai - aisa prastav Rajya Sabha mein upasthit aur matdan karne wale sadasyaon ke do-tihai (2/3) bahumat se paas hona chahiye. Ye adhikar ek baar mein 1 saal ke liye milta hai, par us samay mein paas hue kanoon aage bhi chalu rah sakte hain. Isliye aise mamlon mein rashtrapati ka koi aadesh ya rajyaon ki sahamati zaroori nahi hoti, aur faisla Lok Sabha ka nahi balki Rajya Sabha ka hota hai. Exam point: Article 249 = Rajya Sabha ka 2/3 prastav (upasthit evam matdan) se Parliament ko State List par kanoon banane ka adhikar (1 saal ke liye), rashtriya hit mein.

qe: In the event of a conflict between a Central law and a State law on a Concurrent List subject under Article 254, what is the legal outcome?
qh: अनुच्छेद 254 के तहत समवर्ती सूची के विषय पर केंद्रीय और राज्य कानून के बीच टकराव होने पर क्या कानूनी स्थिति होती है?
o: The law that was passed earlier in time takes permanent precedence
The State law always overrides the Union law
The Union law prevails and the State law is void to the extent of repugnancy, unless the State law was reserved for and received the assent of the President
e: Article 254 ke anusaar agar kisi samanvay (Concurrent) suchi ke vishay par kendra ka kanoon aur rajya ka kanoon aapas mein takrate hain (repugnancy), to kendra ke kanoon ka palan hoga aur rajya ka kanoon us had tak shoonya (void) ho jaayega - haan, ek roshni (exception) yahi hai ki agar rajya ka kanoon rashtrapati ke paas aarakshit (reserved) kiya gaya ho aur rashtrapati ne us par anumodan de diya ho, to rajya ka kanoon chalta rahega; iske alava agar baad mein Parliament usi vishay par kanoon bana de, to Parliamentary kanoon phir bhi praadhaan hoga (254(2)). Isliye 'pehle wala' ya 'hamesha rajya wala' wale vikalp galat hain; 'kendra praadhaan, rajya ke aarakshit kanoon ko chhod kar' sahi hai. Exam point: Article 254 = Concurrent List par takraav mein kendra ka kanoon bhaari, agar rajya ka kanoon rashtrapati ke anumodan ke saath reserved na hua ho.

qe: The 'Zonal Councils' operating in India are which type of bodies?
qh: भारत में कार्यरत 'क्षेत्रीय परिषदें' (Zonal Councils) किस प्रकार के निकाय हैं?
o: Statutory bodies established under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956
Non-statutory executive wings of the NITI Aayog
e: Zonal Councils (kshetriya parishad) Article 263 ke teht nahi, balki 'States Reorganisation Act, 1956' ke teht banaye gaye statutory sansthaayen hain - ye kendra aur rajyaon ke beech tatha rajyaon ke aapas mein samanvay (coordination) aur sahyog ke liye kaam karte hain, aur unki adhyakshta kendra ka Grih Mantri karta hai (kuchh councilon mein kuchh mantri bhi). Article 263 ke teht jo sanstha banti hai wo 'Inter-State Council' hai (rashtrapati ke aadesh se ban sakti hai) - usmein PM adhyaksh hota hai; isliye dono ko mila dena galat hai. NITI Aayog ek executive body hai, jiska zonal council se koi gathan-ya-sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Zonal Councils = States Reorganisation Act, 1956 ke teht statutory; Inter-State Council = Article 263 (rashtrapati ke aadesh se, PM adhyaksh).

qe: What constitutional consequence is provided under Article 365 if a State Government fails to comply with executive directions given by the Union under Article 256 or 257?
qh: यदि कोई राज्य सरकार संघ द्वारा दिए गए निर्देशों का पालन करने में विफल रहती है, तो अनुच्छेद 365 के तहत क्या संवैधानिक परिणाम हो सकता है?
o: The State High Court judges are dismissed immediately
The State's legislative seats are reduced by half
It shall be lawful for the President to hold that a situation has arisen in which the governance of the State cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution (invoking Art 356)
The State is placed under direct military martial administration
e: Article 365 ke anusaar agar rajya sarkar kendra ki executive nirdeshon (jaise Article 256/257 ke teht bhedbhav-rahi ya nirdesh) ka paalan nahi karti, to rashtrapati ke liye yahi maan lena 'vidhipurn' (lawful) ho jaata hai ki rajya mein samvidhan ke anusaar shaasan nahi chal sakta - aur is aadhar par rashtrapati Article 356 ke teht rashtrapati shasan (President's Rule) lagane ka raasta istemal kar sakte hain. Isliye Article 365 ek 'kadi' (hammer) ki tarah hai jo rajya par kendra ki nirdeshon ka paalan karwati hai. High Court ke nyadhiishon ki barkhastagi, vidhayak sadasyon ka adha karna ya military shasan lagana aise parinam nahi hain. Exam point: Article 365 = kendra ki nirdeshon ka paalan na hone par rashtrapati 'shaasan nahi chal sakta' maan sakte hain (356 ka raasta khulta hai).

qe: Under Article 250, when does Parliament acquire the authority to legislate on any matter in the State List for the whole or any part of India?
qh: अनुच्छेद 250 के तहत संसद को पूरे भारत या उसके किसी हिस्से के लिए राज्य सूची के मामलों पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार कब मिलता है?
o: Whenever the Supreme Court issues a suo motu directive
During a Proclamation of National Emergency under Article 352
Only after consulting the Finance Commission
e: Article 250 ke anusaar 'rashtriya aapatkal' (National Emergency, Article 352) ke dauran rajya-suchi (State List) ke vishayon par bhi kendra vidhan kar sakti hai - yani aapatkal mein sansad rajya ke vishayon par bhi kanoon bana sakti hai, par aise kanoon aapatkal ke samapt hone ke 6 mahine ke andar khatm ho jaate hain (jab tak kendra unhe dobara nahi banati). Isliye municipality hartaal, Supreme Court ka suo motu aadesh ya Finance Commission ki salah in vikalpon ka is saath koi sambandh nahi hai - Article 250 ka saath seedha Article 352 se hai. Exam point: Article 250 = aapatkal ke dauran kendra ko State List par bhi vidhan ki shakti (aapatkal khatm hone ke 6 mahine tak prabhavi).

qe: How does the operation of Article 358 differ fundamentally from Article 359 during a National Emergency?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान अनुच्छेद 358 और अनुच्छेद 359 की कार्यप्रणाली में क्या मूलभूत अंतर है?
o: Article 358 deals with financial reductions, while Article 359 deals with armed rebellions
Article 358 applies to State Emergency, while Article 359 applies to National Emergency
Article 358 requires presidential orders, while Article 359 is self-executing

Article 358 automatically suspends the six freedoms of Article 19 on grounds of War/External Aggression, whereas Article 359 empowers the President by order to suspend the enforcement of other specified Fundamental Rights (except Articles 20 and 21)
e: Article 358 aur 359 ka khaas antar unke daayre aur tarike mein hai: Article 358 'sva-kriya' (automatic) hai - jab rashtriya aapatkal 'yuddh ya bahri aakraman' (war or external aggression) ke karan lagta hai, to Article 19 ki chhah swatantrayein apne aap (automatically) suspend ho jaati hain, alag se koi aadesh nahi chahiye. Iske ulat Article 359 ke teht rashtrapati ke aadesh (order) se anya mool adhikaron ke karyanvayan (enforcement) ko suspend kiya ja sakta hai - ismein Article 20 aur 21 kabhi nahi aate. 44th samvidhan sanshodhan (1978) ke baad Article 358 keval 'yuddh ya bahri aakraman' wale aapatkal par lagta hai (internal disturbance par nahi), aur uska lagu poore desh par hi hota hai. Exam point: Article 358 = Article 19 ki azaadiyan automatic suspend (bahri aapatkal mein); Article 359 = rashtrapati ke aadesh se anya mool adhikar suspend, par 20 aur 21 kabhi nahi.

qe: Under Article 356, what is the maximum permissible total period for which President's Rule can remain in force in a State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 356 के तहत किसी राज्य में राष्ट्रपति शासन अधिकतम कितनी अवधि तक लागू रह सकता है?
o: 3 years (with parliamentary approvals every 6 months and specific EC certification after 1 year)
e: Article 356 ke anusaar rashtrapati shasan (President's Rule) ki adhiktam avadhi 3 saal ki hai, lekin ye seedha 3 saal nahi chalti - pehle 2 mahine ke andar sansad ke dono sadanon ki anumodan lena hota hai, phir har 6 mahine par sansad se anumodan karana padta hai. Ek saal ke baad ise badhane ke liye do shartein mein se ek puri karni padti hai - (1) desh mein aapatkal (Article 352) lagu ho, ya (2) nirvachan aayog (Election Commission) satyapit kare ki rajya mein chunav karana sambhav nahi. Isliye 'anel mitra' (indefinite), '5 saal' ya 'hamesha 1 saal' wale vikalp samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: rashtrapati shasan ki adhiktam avadhi = 3 saal (har 6 mahine sansad ki anumodan; 1 saal ke baad EC/presidential certificate ya aapatkal zaroori).

qe: During the proclamation of a Financial Emergency under Article 360, whose salaries and allowances can the President direct to be reduced?
qh: अनुच्छेद 360 के तहत वित्तीय आपातकाल के दौरान राष्ट्रपति किसके वेतन और भत्तों में कटौती का निर्देश दे सकते हैं?
o: All persons serving the Union and States, including Judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts
e: Vittiya aapatkal (Financial Emergency, Article 360) ke dauran rashtrapati nirdesh (direction) de sakte hain ki kendra aur rajyaon ke sabhi sevaarthiyon (servants) - jismein Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay aur High Courts ke nyayadhish bhi SHAAMIL hain - ke vetan (salaries) aur bhatte (allowances) kam kiye jayein; yani aise samay mein nyayapalika ke vetan par bhi kadahi lag sakti hai. Ye nirdesh Rajya ke vitta-aur-anyas (all money bills) ko rashtrapati ki purv-sahmati ke liye bhejne ke saath bhi juda hai. Isliye 'keval rajya sarkari adhikari' ya 'keval MPs/MLAs' wale vikalp chhote ya galat hain - pravdhan sabhi ('all persons serving the Union and States, including judges') par lagu hota hai. Exam point: Financial Emergency (Article 360) mein rashtrapati kendra-rajya ke sabhi sevaarthiyon aur nyayadhishon tak ke vetan-bhatte kam karwane ka nirdesh de sakte hain.

qe: In the landmark 'S.R. Bommai v. Union of India (1994)' ruling, what constitutional safeguards were established against the arbitrary use of Article 356?
qh: 'एस.आर. बोम्मई मामले (1994)' में अनुच्छेद 356 के मनमाने प्रयोग के खिलाफ क्या संवैधानिक सुरक्षा उपाय तय किए गए?
o: Proclamation under Article 356 was made subject to judicial review, floor of the Assembly was made the sole forum to test majority, and secularism was held as part of the Basic Structure
The office of the Governor was made an elected post
President's Rule was declared immune from court review
e: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India (1994) mein Supreme Court ne Article 356 ke durupyog (misuse) par teen bade kavad lagaye - (1) rashtrapati shasan ki ghoshna nyayik samiksha (judicial review) ke adheen hai, yani adalat usse parkh sakti hai, (2) bahumat ka parikshan (floor test) sadan ke floor par hi hoga, Rajyapal ki report ya andaza se nahi, aur agar bahumat sabit ho to sarkar bahaal ki ja sakti hai, aur (3) dharmanirapekshata (secularism) samvidhan ki aadharik sanrachna ka hissa hai, isliye uske aadhar par bhi kisi sarkar ko hatana galat thahraya ja sakta hai. Isi faisle ne yahi spasht kiya ki rajya vidhan sabha ko bhang karne ki puri power adalat ke nirikshan mein hai. Exam point: S.R. Bommai (1994) = Article 356 par nyayik samiksha, floor test hi bahumat ka ekmatra aadhar, secularism basic structure ka hissa.

qe: What restriction was placed by the 44th Constitutional Amendment Act (1978) on the invocation of National Emergency under Article 352?
qh: 44वें संविधान संशोधन (1978) ने अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत आपातकाल लागू करने पर क्या रोक लगाई?
o: The President can proclaim emergency only upon receiving the written recommendation of the Union Cabinet (not Prime Minister alone)
It can be proclaimed only after prior approval from the Chief Justice of India
It requires a referendum by the citizens
The emergency can last only for a non-extendable 21 days
e: 44th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1978 ne Article 352 ko rokne ke liye kadi shart lagayi - ab rashtrapati rashtriya aapatkal (National Emergency) ki ghoshna keval tabhi kar sakte hain jab unhe kendra mantri-parishad (Union Cabinet) ki likhit sifarish (written recommendation) mile, na ki keval Pradhan Mantri ki salah se. Isi sanshodhan ne 'aantarik ashanti' (internal disturbance) shabd ko hata kar 'sashastr vidroh' (armed rebellion) jaisa kasa shabd (tight word) rakha, aur aapatkal ko 6 mahine ke liye sansad ki anumodan ke bina nahi chalne dena, plus aapatkal ko 1 mahine ke andar sadan ke samaksh rakhna aadi shartein bhi jodin. Ye sab 1975 wale Emergency ke anubhav se seekh kar kiye gaye. 'CJI ki purv-anumati', 'janmat-sangrah (referendum)' ya '21 din' wale vikalp samvidhan mein nahi hain. Exam point: 44th sanshodhan (1978) - National Emergency ke liye Union Cabinet ki likhit sifarish; 'internal disturbance' ki jagah 'armed rebellion'.

qe: Which Article gives the State Legislature the constitutional power to adopt any official language for use within that State?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य विधानमंडल को राज्य के भीतर उपयोग के लिए आधिकारिक भाषा चुनने की शक्ति देता है?
e: Article 345 ke anusaar rajya ka vidhan mandal kanoon bana kar rajya ke bhitar (within the State) istemal ke liye ek ya adhik bhashaen (official language) apna sakta hai - yani Hindi, ya rajya ki kisi bhi bhasha, ya ek se adhik bhashaen rajya ki aadhikarik bhasha ho sakti hain (aur agar aisi vidhi na banayi gayi to rajya ki aadhikarik bhasha Hindi hi maani jaati hai). Article 343 ke teht kendra ki aadhikarik bhasha Hindi (Devanagari script) hai, Article 348 ke teht adalaton aur vidheyakon (bills) ki bhasha angrezi hai, aur Article 351 Hindi ke vikas ka nirdesh deta hai. Isliye rajya ki aadhikarik bhasha chunne ka adhikar Article 345 se milta hai. Exam point: rajya ki aadhikarik bhasha chunna = Article 345 (vidhan mandal ka kanoon); kendra ki bhasha = 343, nyayalayon ki bhasha = 348.

qe: Under Article 253, what extraordinary power does Parliament possess regarding implementation of international treaties?
qh: अनुच्छेद 253 के तहत अंतरराष्ट्रीय संधियों को लागू करने के लिए संसद के पास कौन सी असाधारण शक्ति है?
o: Power to renegotiate borders without constitutional amendments
Power to make any law for the whole or part of India for implementing any treaty or convention, even if the subject falls within the State List
Power to suspend all fundamental rights permanently
Power to dismiss non-compliant foreign ambassadors
e: Article 253 ke anusaar Parliament ko 'sanghaya (Union) ki karyapalika shakti' ke roop mein aisa kanoon banane ki shakti hai jo poore bharat ya uske kisi bhaag ke liye ho, chahe wo vishay samanvay (Concurrent) ya kisi bhi suchi (State List bhi) mein ho - ise keval isliye banaya jaata hai ki bharat apne antarrashtriya sandhi/bempatra (treaty/convention) aur sammelan (conference) ke faislon ko lagu kar sake. Isliye ek sandhi par hui pratibaddhata (obligation) ke palan ke liye kendra aise vishayon par bhi kanoon bana sakti hai jo samanya roop se rajyaon ke paas hote hain, jaisa lok-sabha (Lok Sabha) ke kshetra mein kuchh mamlon mein hua. Seema-badal, mool adhikar ya foreign ambassadors se juda vikalp iske daayre mein nahi aate. Exam point: Article 253 = antarrashtriya sandhi/samjhauton ke karyanvayan ke liye Parliament poore desh ya bhaag ke liye kanoon bana sakti hai, chahe vishay State List ka ho.

qe: Under Article 352, within what period must a Proclamation of National Emergency be approved by both Houses of Parliament after the 44th Amendment, and by what majority?
qh: अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत 44वें संशोधन के बाद राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल की घोषणा को संसद के दोनों सदनों से कितने समय में और किस बहुमत से स्वीकृति मिलनी चाहिए?
o: Within one month, by a special majority of each House
Within two months, by a simple majority of each House
Within six months, by a special majority of the Lok Sabha only
Within 21 days, by a majority of the total membership of the Rajya Sabha
e: Article 352 ke teht rashtrapati ki aapatkal ghoshna (Proclamation of Emergency) ko sansad ke dono sadanon se ek mahine ke andar vishesh bahumat (special majority) se manzoori leni padti hai - vishesh bahumat ka matlab hai us sadan ke kul sadasyaon ka bahumat aur upasthit tatha matdan karne wale sadasyaon ke do-tihai se zyada ka samarthan. 44th sanshodhan (1978) se pehle ye samay-seema do mahine ki thi; ise ghata kar ek mahina kiya gaya, taaki sansad ki nigrani tej ho jaaye. Manzoori ke baad aapatkal chhah-chhah mahine ke liye jaari rehta hai aur har chhah mahine par dobara isi tarah manzoori leni hoti hai. Yadi proklameshan ke samay Lok Sabha bhang ho jaati hai to Rajya Sabha ki manzoori se 30 din tak ye jaari reh sakta hai, aur nayi Lok Sabha ki pehli baithak ke 30 din ke andar dono sadanon se manzoori leni hoti hai. Isliye do mahine ya simple majority wale, chhah mahine keval Lok Sabha wale, ya 21 din Rajya Sabha wale vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: aapatkal ghoshna = ek mahine ke andar dono sadanon ka vishesh bahumat; uske baad har 6 mahine par manzoori.

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment inserted the safeguard allowing at least one-tenth of the members of the Lok Sabha to requisition a special sitting to consider a resolution disapproving the continuance of a National Emergency?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल जारी रखने के विरुद्ध प्रस्ताव पर विचार करने के लिए लोकसभा के कम से कम एक-दशमांश सदस्यों को विशेष बैठक बुलाने का अधिकार किस संविधान संशोधन ने जोड़ा?
e: 44th sanshodhan (1978) ne aapatkal ke dauran sansad ki nigrani ko mazboot karne ke liye ek khaas vyavastha jodi - Lok Sabha ke kam se kam ek-dashmash (1/10) sadasya adhyaksh (Speaker) ko likhit soochna de kar vishesh baithak (special sitting) bulwa sakte hain, jismein aapatkal jaari rakhne ke khilaf prastav par vichaar hota hai; aisi baithak aam taur par soochna milne ke 14 din ke andar bulani hoti hai. Yadi Lok Sabha aisa prastav paas kar deti hai to rashtrapati par aapatkal wapas lene ki baadhyata hoti hai, isliye ise 'disapproval resolution' kaha jaata hai. 42nd sanshodhan (1976) ne aapatkal ke pravdhan aur bhi aasaan kiye the, aur 44th sanshodhan ne unhe kasht kiya; 38th sanshodhan 1975 mein aaya tha par aisi vyavastha usne nahi di, aur 1st sanshodhan 1951 mein kheti-sudhaar aur freespeech sambandhi the. Isliye sahi jod 44th sanshodhan hai. Exam point: 1/10 Lok Sabha sadasya ki soochna par vishesh baithak = 44th sanshodhan (1978) ki vyavastha; Lok Sabha ka disapproval prastav rashtrapati ke liye baadhyakari hai.

qe: The 44th Constitutional Amendment Act (1978) substituted a new ground for a National Emergency in Article 352. Which substitution was made?
qh: 44वें संविधान संशोधन (1978) ने अनुच्छेद 352 में राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल का जो आधार बदला, वह कौन-सा था?
o: 'War' was deleted and replaced by 'external disturbance'
e: Samvidhan mein aapatkal (National Emergency) ghoshan ke teen aadhaar hain - yuddh (war), baahya aakraman (external aggression) aur sashast vidroh (armed rebellion). 1975 ke aapatkal ne dikhaya ki 'internal disturbance' jaise dhundhle (vague) shabd ka durupayog ho sakta hai, isliye 44th sanshodhan (1978) ne 'internal disturbance' ko hata kar 'armed rebellion' lagu kiya, jiska matlab hai sashas astra-dhari vidroh ya uski aashanka, aur ise vaidh karne ke liye kendra mantri-parishad ki likhit sifarish bhi zaroori kar di gayi (keval Pradhan Mantri ki salah par nahi). 'War' aur 'external aggression' wala aadhaar barkaraar raha - unhe badla nahi gaya. Isliye baaki vikalp galat hain. Exam point: 44th sanshodhan 1978 ne 'internal disturbance' ko 'armed rebellion' se badla; aapatkal ke aadhaar ab war, external aggression aur armed rebellion hain.

qe: During the operation of a National Emergency, how can the life of the Lok Sabha be extended by law, and what is the position after the Emergency ceases?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान कानून द्वारा लोकसभा का कार्यकाल कैसे बढ़ाया जा सकता है और आपातकाल समाप्त होने पर स्थिति क्या होती है?
o: By a Presidential order for two years at a time, with no outer limit
By a law of Parliament for one year at a time, and not beyond six months after the Emergency ceases to operate
By a resolution of the Rajya Sabha for three years at a time
The life of the Lok Sabha cannot be extended under any circumstance
e: Article 83(2) ke anusaar jab rashtriya aapatkal chal raha ho, sansad kanoon bana kar Lok Sabha ka karyakal ek baar mein ek saal ke liye badha sakti hai, aur aise kanoon aapatkal samapt hone ke baad chhah mahine se zyada loktantra ke karyakal ko nahi badha sakte. Kabhi aishy hi karyakal ghata bhi sakti hai (agar aapatkal ke bina chunav ka faisla ho). Isi tarah rajya vidhan sabhaon ke liye Article 172 mein laxman-rekha hai. 1975 ke aapatkal mein isi pravdhan ke teht Lok Sabha ka karyakal badhaya gaya tha, jise baad mein 44th sanshodhan ne wapas paanch saal ka saamaanya niyam samajh me hi la kar istemal ko niyamit kiya. Rashtrapati ke aadesh, Rajya Sabha ke prastav ya karyakal ke kisi poorn niyam se ye nahi hota - hamesha sansad ke kanoon se. Isliye sahi jod ek saal, ek baar mein aur samapt honay ke baad chhah mahine wala hai. Exam point: aapatkal mein Lok Sabha ka karyakal = ek saal ke liye (election badhna), aapatkal khatam hone ke 6 mahine ke andar faisla chunav se hoga (Article 83).

qe: Under Article 356, which two conditions must be satisfied for President's Rule in a State to remain in force beyond one year?
qh: अनुच्छेद 356 के तहत किसी राज्य में राष्ट्रपति शासन एक वर्ष से आगे चलाने के लिए कौन-सी दो शर्तें पूरी होनी चाहिए?
o: A resolution of the Rajya Sabha and a report of the Supreme Court
Approval of the Inter-State Council and a fresh general election
Two-thirds majority of the State Legislative Assembly and the report of the Governor
A National Emergency must be in operation in the whole or part of the State and the Election Commission must certify that elections cannot be held
e: 44th sanshodhan (1978) ne Article 356 mein sakht shart lagai - rajyapati ka aadesh aam roop se chhah mahine ke liye hota hai aur sansad ki manzoori se ek saal tak chal sakta hai; uske baad ise jaari rakhne ke liye do shartein ek saath poori honi chahiye: (1) poore Bharat ya us rajya ke kisi bhaag mein rashtriya aapatkal lagu ho, aur (2) nirvachan aayog (Election Commission) praman-patr de ki rajya mein vidhan sabha ke chunav karana sambhav nahi hai. Aisi har ek-saala/bodh avadhi har chhah mahine ke liye badhai ja sakti hai, par kul mila kar teen saal se zyada nahi. Vidhan sabha ka bahumat, rajya sabha ka prastav, suprit court ki report ya antar-rajya parishad ki manzoori samvidhan ke pravdhanon mein nahi hai. Dhyan rahe - pehle saal ke baad bhi har badhai alag se sansad ke dono sadanon se pass karani hoti hai. Exam point: ek saal ke baad President's Rule = rashtriya aapatkal + ECI praman-patr se chhah-chhah mahine badhti hai, kul seema teen saal (Article 356).

qe: Which statement about a Proclamation of Financial Emergency under Article 360 is legally correct?
qh: अनुच्छेद 360 के तहत वित्तीय आपातकाल की घोषणा के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: It lapses automatically after six months even if Parliament approves it
It can be proclaimed only after the Reserve Bank Governor gives written advice
It must be approved by both Houses within two months, can continue indefinitely once approved, and has never been invoked in India
It requires ratification by not less than half of the State Legislatures within one year
e: Article 360 ke teht rashtrapati vittya aapatkal ki ghoshna tab kar sakte hain jab Bharat ki vittya sthirta, videshi karja ya currency ke liye khatra ho. Ise do mahine ke andar sansad ke dono sadanon se manzoori karani hoti hai; manzoori ke baad ise jaari rakhne ke liye kisi samay-seema (maximum duration) ka pravdhan nahi hai - yani yahi ek aisa aapatkal hai jiske liye koi maximum avadhi tay nahi hai. Iske prabhav: kendra Rajyaon ko vittya shishtachar (financial propriety) ke niyam maanne ka nirdesh de sakta hai, rashtrapati kendra/rajya ke sabhi karyakartaon aur Supreme Court ya High Court ke judge ki salary-bhatta ghata sakte hain, aur vidheyak rashtrapati ki manzoori ke bina pesh nahi hote. Aaj tak ek baar bhi vittya aapatkal lagu nahi hua. Reserve Bank ke Governor ki likhit salah ya aadhi vidhan sabhaon ka anumodan aise pravdhanon mein nahi hai. Exam point: vittya aapatkal (Article 360) = do mahine mein manzoori, koi maximum avadhi nahi, aaj tak kabhi lagu nahi hua.

qe: What duty does Article 355 impose on the Union in relation to the States?
qh: अनुच्छेद 355 राज्यों के संबंध में संघ पर क्या कर्तव्य डालता है?
o: To conduct elections to State Assemblies through the Union Public Service Commission
To sanction financial grants to every State during a President's Rule
To appoint the Chief Minister in case of a hung Assembly
To protect every State against external aggression and internal disturbance and to ensure that its governance is carried on in accordance with the Constitution
e: Article 355 kendra par do-tarfa zimmedari daalta hai: (1) har rajya ko baahya aakraman (external aggression) aur aantarik upadrav (internal disturbance) se bachana, aur (2) ye sunishchit karna ki rajya ka prashasan samvidhan ke anusaar hi chale. Ye pravdhan koi 'shakti' nahi deta - ye keval ek kartavya hai; shakti Article 356 mein hai, jiske teht kendra sandhish sarkar ki gatividhi ke aadhar par rashtrapati ke aadesh ki sifarish kar sakta hai aur kendra aage badh sakta hai. Supreme Court ne apne nirnayon mein saaf kiya ki Article 355 ka kartavya Article 356 ki shakton ka aadhar hai, isliye rashtrapati-sasan ek apvaad (exception) hai aur norm nahi, aur governance ko chalu rakhna pehla vikalp hona chahiye. Vittiya sahayta, mukhya mantri ki niyukti ya rajya-chunav karana is Article ka kaam nahi - rajya ke chunav ka pravdhan rajyapal aur nirvachan aayog karte hain. Exam point: Article 355 = kendra ka kartavya (bahya aakraman aur aantarik upadrav se raksha + samvidhanik sarkar sunishchit karna); Article 356 iska upyog-niyam hai.

qe: How many times has a National Emergency under Article 352 been proclaimed in India, and on what grounds?
qh: भारत में अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल कितनी बार घोषित हुआ है और किन आधारों पर?
o: Once, in 1975, on the ground of internal disturbance
Twice, in 1962 and 1975, both on external grounds
Three times: 1962 and 1971 on external grounds, and 1975 on the ground of internal disturbance
e: Bharat mein rashtriya aapatkal ab tak teen baar lagaya gaya hai: 1962 mein cheen ke aakraman (Chinese aggression) ke samay, 1971 mein Pakistan ke saath yuddh ke samay aur 1975 mein antarik ashanti (internal disturbance) ke aadhar par. 1962 aur 1971 wale aapatkal bahya aakraman se jude the, jabki 1975 wala aapatkal aantarik aadhar par tha, aur isi ke badle 44th sanshodhan (1978) ne 'internal disturbance' shabd hata kar 'armed rebellion' kar diya aur likhit cabinet sifarish zaroori kar di. 1975 ke aapatkal ke dauran hi 42nd sanshodhan (1976) laaya gaya tha, jismein karyapalika ki shaktiyan badhi; isi karan 1977 ke baad 44th sanshodhan se vyavastha mein sudhaar kiye gaye. 1965 ya 1971 ke alawa koi 'chautha' aapatkal nahi hua, aur aapatkal ki ghoshan 'internal disturbance' ke aadhar par ek hi baar (1975) hui thi. Exam point: aapatkal teen baar - 1962 (cheen), 1971 (Pakistan yuddh), 1975 (internal disturbance); 44th sanshodhan ke baad aadhaar 'armed rebellion' hua.
